# SGCarAccident

> Step-by-step help after a car accident in Singapore: at fault, not sure, or not at fault (third-party claim); minor accidents; hit and run; insurer reporting centres; accident statement helper; private settlement form; windscreen claims. General guidance, not an insurer or law firm.
